greetings.text: Ah! 'Tis you. Fine mornin', if it holds. My knees say rain.
Well, well. Come to see how the garden fares? Don't tread on the beans.
Ah, what a to-do, what a to-do. Strange times, I says, strange times.
Mr. Frodo's gone, gone off to Buckland, and Sam with him. And that Lobelia in the hole!

farewells.text: Ah, well, I'll be about my taters. Mind the lane.
Well, good day. And don't believe all you hear at the Ivy Bush.

smalltalk.text: Taters, I says. Boiled, mashed, stewed or in a stew. Where's the harm in 'em?
Old Mr. Bilbo, he was a gentlehobbit, and so's Mr. Frodo. Queer, but gentle.
My Sam's a good lad, and a better gardener than I'd ever been at his age. Don't tell him I said so.
Elves and dragons! Sam's head is stuffed with 'em. No good'll come of it.

frodo_sold_bag_end.text: Sold, it is! And to them Sackville-Bagginses, if you please. After all these years. I says to Sam, I says: that's the end of the Hill as we know it.

black_rider_in_hobbiton.text: A tall black fellow, he was, at my gate, asking after Mr. Baggins. Voice like a snake in dry leaves. I told him Buckland, and I wish I hadn't now.

strange_folk_on_east_road.text: Strange folk all along the East Road, I hear. Dwarves and worse. Never held with it myself.
